lastCompletedStory.title: CRITICAL: The headless argv omits `--agent subagent-implementer`. The tmux impl…

openQuestions: scripts/cam/prd.json carried a pre-existing uncommitted diff at the START of this story (US-R1-002..US-R1-006, five more round-1 review findings: missing --permission-mode, missing CAM_WORKER=1 env, stale README, headless ignoring implBackend, and a sixth truncated in this session's git status). This story did NOT create that diff and did not commit it (per AGENT.md 'Do not edit prd.json'). Whoever picks up US-R1-002 next should confirm prd.json still carries those five stories uncommitted-or-committed-by-someone-else before assuming they self-select correctly; if the supervisor's own commit machinery expects prd.json to already be clean at dispatch time, that assumption was violated coming into this session.
nextStoryContext: US-R1-001 fixed the CRITICAL headless --agent omission (round-1 review finding on CAM-516's own prior PRD): buildHeadlessChildInvocation (src/supervisor/headless-argv.ts) now takes a REQUIRED agentName field (not optional/defaulted -- a second source of truth for the implementer agent name was rejected) and always appends `--agent <agentName>` to the argv, right after --verbose and before --model. The thread runs loop.ts's headlessDispatchFn params (new required agentName field on the RunSupervisorOptions['headlessDispatchFn'] param type) -> the one production call site in loop.ts passes `agentName: DEFAULT_IMPLEMENTER_AGENT` (the same constant the three tmux buildSpawnArgv call sites in this file already resolve to; there is no RunSupervisorOptions.agentName override on either path) -> host.ts's headlessDispatchFn closure forwards params.agentName into buildHeadlessChildInvocation. Existing headless-argv.test.ts calls were all updated to pass a TEST_AGENT_NAME (= DEFAULT_IMPLEMENTER_AGENT, imported from backend-adapter.ts) since the field is now required; two new tests pin --agent's presence and that it carries the CALLER-supplied value, not a hardcoded default. headless-route.test.ts's 'routes implementer dispatch' test additionally asserts headlessCalls[0].agentName === DEFAULT_IMPLEMENTER_AGENT end to end through runSupervisor. file-size-budget.json raised host.ts 1191->1192 and loop.ts 2934->2946 (gate-measured content.split('\n').length actuals) with a dated US-R1-001 _ref entry. Next implementer picking up a US-R1-* story from this same round-1 review batch: prd.json at session start already carried US-R1-002 (missing --permission-mode in headless argv, same headless-argv.ts file this story touched -- expect a merge/overlap in that file's diff region around the argv array), US-R1-003 (missing CAM_WORKER=1 in the headless child env, stripHeadlessChildEnv in the same file), US-R1-004 (README staleness), US-R1-005 (headless ignores implBackend, loop.ts same dispatch branch this story touched), uncommitted -- see openQuestions above.

officialDocsValidated.summary: Confirmed --agent takes a string agent-name argument, overrides the agent config setting, and combines freely with -p/--print (only --bg/--background is documented as incompatible with -p). The fix (adding --agent <agentName> to the headless argv, right where the tmux ClaudeAdapter.buildSpawnArgv already places it) matches current CLI behavior.
